questions.q1: What makes Slovenščina Korak za Korkom different from other language learning programs?
questions.q2: Do I need any prior knowledge of Slovene (or other languages) to start?
questions.q4: Can I try a lesson before committing to a full course?

answers.a1: Slovenščina Korak za Korkom offers a personalized learning experience tailored to your needs. We focus on practical communication skills rather than just memorizing vocabulary. Our lessons are interactive and flexible, with experienced tutors who guide you step by step. Whether you’re a beginner or improving your fluency, we ensure a structured and engaging learning journey.
answers.a2: Not at all! Our program is designed for all levels, from complete beginners to advanced learners. If you already have some knowledge, we will assess your level and customize the lessons to help you progress efficiently.
answers.a3: Our lessons are conducted via live video sessions with experienced tutors. You’ll have interactive exercises, real-time feedback, and customized materials. You can choose your schedule and learn at your own pace, making it easy to fit language learning into your daily routine.
answers.a4: Yes! We offer a trial lesson so you can experience our teaching approach firsthand. This helps you understand how our program works and allows us to assess your level and learning goals. Sign up today and start your language journey with confidence!

mission.title: How it all started
mission.subtitle: Our story
mission.text1: It all started with us, me and my sister. My name is Oleksandr, and hers is Sofia. Today we are the founders of the program, but we moved to Slovenia together with our family.
mission.text2: We moved to Slovenia 12 years ago, to a small town called Mozirje in the Lower Savinja Valley, with a population of around 5,000 people. Most of you have probably never even heard of this place. I was 11 at the time, and Sofia was 8. Like most people who move to a new country, we faced stress, adaptation challenges, the fear of not being accepted in a new environment, and of course, the language barrier.
mission.text3: At school, we were welcomed very warmly. Teachers and classmates supported us, helped us, and guided us during the first months. We didn’t experience any bullying or discrimination. But opposite, we felt openness and kindness. At the same time, we had to learn the language from the beginning, with the help of teachers, classmates, and additional Slovenian lessons at school. Back then, there was almost no English-speaking community in Mozirje, unlike today in Ljubljana or other larger cities, so we had no choice. We had to communicate, make new friends, learn the language, and integrate into society as quickly as possible.
mission.text4: We attended various activities such as music school, kickboxing training, and ballroom dancing, where communication was entirely in Slovenian. It was in this environment that we truly began to understand the living language, slang, and the features of everyday communication, gradually expanding our vocabulary. Because of this, we learned Slovenian relatively quickly, became confident, made new friends, and built strong connections that the language opened for us.
mission.text5: That is why today we deeply understand all the nuances of the language, not only grammar, but also how people speak in real life. We grew up in this environment and went through the entire integration process ourselves, step by step.
mission.text6: Later, we successfully finished school, passed the final exams (NPZ), and enrolled in the First Gymnasium in Celje, where we continued our education and immersed ourselves even more deeply in the language. This gave us a strong grammatical foundation and a clear understanding of the structure of the Slovenian language. In the end, we successfully passed the Matura exam with a high average score and, through our own experience, learned how to properly approach exam preparation and language learning.
mission.text7: After that Sofia pursued a degree in law, while I chose economics, where I have already completed my degree and am currently finishing my master’s studies. However, even in the period between finishing gymnasium and starting university, we realized that we could share our knowledge and experience with others who are just beginning their journey in Slovenia. That is how our work gradually began.
mission.text8: For more than three years now, we have been developing this project, continuously improving and adapting our program to the real needs of our students. Over this time, we have come a long way, and today, together with our students, we can confidently say that we work at all levels, from teaching the language from scratch to preparing for school, state, and specialized exams of all levels.
mission.text9: We continue to improve and are genuinely passionate about what we do, as well as proud of our students’ results, because we have gone through this journey ourselves and truly understand all the nuances, challenges, and hidden difficulties that can arise during the learning process.

built.title: Why we do what we do
built.subtitle: How the project developed
built.text1: After going through the process of integration and language learning ourselves, we realized that we could help others go through it faster, more easily, and with greater confidence.
built.text2: At the beginning, it was simply individual lessons and helping friends who had just moved to Slovenia. We shared our experience, explained the language in a simple and understandable way, and helped people in real-life situations. At that stage, it felt more like a small hobby than a professional tutoring.
built.text3: Over time, people started to recognize us, recommend us to their friends, and a waiting list gradually began to form. At the same time, we were still students, so our time was limited due to studies and sports.
built.text4: As the number of students grew, so did our understanding of what truly effective learning should look like. We began to structure our knowledge, build a clear program, test different approaches, and continuously improve the learning process.
built.text5: Over time, we developed various approaches tailored to people with different language-learning goals. We learned how to carefully select and use study materials, combining the best available textbooks with our own resources. As a result, we built an extensive digital library of materials, which we provide to our students and teach them how to use effectively.
built.text6: We realized that in our original format we could no longer keep up with the growing number of students, so we began not only to systematize but also to optimize and scale our work. We created Instagram and Telegram channels where everyone can explore our approach and start learning Slovenian in an accessible and practical way. There we share grammar explanations, interactive learning videos, vocabulary, exercises, and useful resources that help people achieve their goals, and all this content is available for free to everyone.
built.text7: The next important step was building a team. We understood that native speakers can convey the language in the most accurate and natural way, so we started looking for teachers among Slovenians through school and university connections. As a result, we assembled a strong team of philology and Slovene studies students who had already been studying English as a second language and had developed teaching skills.
built.text8: We further trained them in our methodology, shared all our developed systems, and focused on the practical side of teaching. Each teacher went through a careful selection process and was tested in real work with students. Today, this is a team of professionals we fully trust, and in some aspects, they even surpass us.
built.text9: The next stage of development was creating additional opportunities for our students. We began introducing options that make learning more interesting and effective. This led to the creation of a speaking club, as well as the website you are currently on, where you can start learning with us immediately after registering
built.text10: Our entire system is designed to make the learning process as simple and effective as possible for both students and teachers. We recommend registering and trying a free trial lesson to experience our approach firsthand.
built.text11: We continue to actively develop the project. Soon, new learning formats will be available on the platform, including video courses and AI for learning Slovenian. We are already working on this right now.
